subject.title: Add tree view command to visualize active agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a first-class active-agent tree surface now, and should it live under `openclaw tree`, `openclaw sessions tree`, the TUI, or an existing subagent/session API?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but the command namespace, JSON fields, watch behavior, and resource accounting would become public product/API contracts.

options.title: Approve narrow tree MVP
options.body: Add a read-only hierarchy renderer over existing session/subagent lineage with text and JSON output, while deferring watch mode and process resource metrics.

options.title: Fold into recursive listing
options.body: Treat this as dependent on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/47320 and expose hierarchy through subagent/session list depth options instead of a new root command.

options.title: Defer for chain metadata design
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/11040 to settle root/trace chain metadata before adding a user-facing tree view.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow tree MVP
recommendation.body: Add a read-only hierarchy renderer over existing session/subagent lineage with text and JSON output, while deferring watch mode and process resource metrics.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest history owner across the CLI sessions and session lineage surfaces and is the best available product/API decision owner from the evidence.
